Statement of Mayor Joy Belmonte

We extend our sincere gratitude to Department of Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon for his swift and proactive response to the drainage and flooding concerns we raised in relation to the MRT-7 project.

We also commend the MRT-7 management for their immediate action in clearing construction sites and removing debris that had been obstructing the flow of rainwater in our drainage systems. Their responsiveness reflects a strong commitment to public safety and accountability.

Our City Engineering Department is now working in close coordination with the DOTr, MMDA, and MRT-7 management to sustain the clearing operations and implement long-term solutions to construction-related obstructions. This unified approach is critical in addressing the root causes of flooding and in safeguarding the well-being of our communities.

We thank all partners involved for demonstrating that through collaboration, we can respond effectively to urgent challenges and deliver meaningful results for our constituents.
